messages:
Maya: Quick intake — AcmeHealth requested per-tenant dynamic caching + per-tenant SLOs for Dedicated. Asking PM/Eng: what belongs in the PRD skeleton? Problem statement, goals, non-goals, success metrics, rollout plan.

Anil: Do we have their traffic profile? qps, burst patterns, tail latency requirements?

Maya: @Anil, sent sample telemetry earlier: 3 tenants show 60% of requests are repeat prefixes; 90p latency requirement is 150ms p50/p95 target varies by tenant. I'll paste cropped stats.

Maya: ```
tenant: acme-prod
qps: 1200 avg, bursts to 6k
repeats: 58%
lat_req: p95 < 150ms
``` 

Liz: Non-goal: not implementing hard multi-tenant isolation on shared GPUs for v1. We scope to dedicated pools per-customer or tenant-aware routing to dedicated nodes.

Oscar: Implementation notes: dynamic prefix cache (per-tenant) + config layer for per-tenant batch sizing. Will need caching invalidation API and memory/quota accounting. Also need fallback policy to global cache.

Jun: Acceptance criteria proposal:
- End-to-end request path honors tenant cache key and returns cached tokens when available.
- Per-tenant SLOs computed and visible in Console (p50/p95/p99 + cost delta).
- Rollout: can toggle tenant caching on/off without restart.
- Safety: cache must not leak tokens across tenants.

Eva: Success metrics:
- 30–50% token cost reduction for cached workloads within first month.
- Maintain p95 latency <= tenant SLA for 95% of windows.
- No cache-cross contamination incidents in canary.

Anil: Edge cases to call out in PRD:
- Very large KV cache growth for one tenant starving others — we need per-tenant quotas.
- Model variants with incompatible KV formats — we need compatibility check.
- Cold start traffic spike after cache eviction.

Maya: Rollout plan sketch:
1) internal alpha on staging with synthetic tenants (2 weeks)
2) limited canary with 1 low-risk customer on Dedicated (2 weeks)
3) broader opt-in beta with 10 tenants (4 weeks)
4) GA with docs + migration guide

product-bot: PRD template: https://redwood.co/prd-templates/per-tenant-caching

Liz: Quick example config for Console UI to allow per-tenant SLOs:
```yaml
tenant: acme-prod
cache_policy:
  enabled: true
  max_entries: 200000
  eviction: lru
slo:
  p95_ms: 150
  cost_budget_per_hour: 5.0
``` 

Oscar: Risks/mitigations to include:
- Memory blowouts -> enforce hard caps + OOM guard
- Incorrect cache keys -> unit tests + fuzz tests
- Regression to latency -> perf harness and A/B rollout

Maya: OK — can someone own the PRD draft? @Liz? If not I can start a skeleton and tag owners.

Liz: I can take first draft. Will put up PRD doc by EOD Thursday. Will add acceptance criteria, edge cases, and initial measurement plan.

Jun: I'll sketch the API endpoints for cache control and quota (open PR on Monday).

Eva: I'll prepare evaluation harness with synthetic repeats and perf baselines.

Maya: Thanks all. Next sync Friday 11am to review draft. :thumbsup:

Anil: noted. I'll add a short perf test matrix to the PRD.

Oscar: +1

product-bot: Reminder: add 'security review' tag before canary.

Maya: tagging @security once doc is up. Closing loop here — ping if blockers.
